sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Named one of the 10 greatest string quartets of all time by BBC Music Magazine, the Pavel Haas Quartet brings a stunning all-Czech program, from the shadow-gathering third quartet of Pavel Haas to the urgent Janáček and the warm-hearted Dvořák "American" quartet.
body: Veronika Jarůšková violin Marek Zwiebel violin Šimon Truszka viola Peter Jarůšek cello Experience the Pavel Haas Quartet, one of BBC Music Magazine's top 10 string quartets of all time, in a stunning all-Czech program. In Pavel Haas's third and final quartet, shadows gather as war approaches. Leoš Janáček's First Quartet, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's novella The Kreutzer Sonata, pulses with urgency and emotional intensity. The evening concludes with the openhearted warmth of Antonín Dvořák's "American" Quartet, composed among Czech immigrants in Iowa and shaped by the spirituals and folk traditions he encountered there.
